neighbours.mechanism_note: Similar symptoms, different cause. progressive external ophthalmoplegia with mitochondrial DNA deletions, autosomal dominant 3: mitochondrial energy metabolism (via MONDO:0004069 inborn mitochondrial metabolism disorder). Sandhoff disease, adult form: lysosomal storage (degradation inside the lysosome fails) (via MONDO:0002561 lysosomal storage disease). No shared causal gene; phenotype similarity simGIC 0.19. Assets and trial designs do not transfer between them without expert review.
